sources.title: Fine-Tune a Tool-Calling LLM with Qwen3-0.6B and LoRA: Full…
sources.snippet: The tutorial builds a full supervised fine-tuning pipeline for Qwen3-0.6B using the XYZ-Aquila-SFT dataset on Hugging Face. LoRA is applied with rank 16, a learning rate of 1e-4, and a maximum of 30 training steps with gradient accumulation over 8 steps. The pipeline streams 400 dataset rows, evaluates on 40, and runs 24 post-training eval probes. Tool-call trajectories are parsed from ChatML ...

The Qwen3‑0.6B is a state‑of‑the‑art multilingual language model with 0.6 billion parameters, excelling in language understanding, generation, coding, and mathematics.
